ace.label: ACE-Step 1.5 XL turbo
prompts: mellow jazz piano trio, brushed drums
epic film score with strings and brass

lora.label: Text slider
lora.note: A LoRA trained from a prompt pair, scaled by the slider position. Same cost as plain generation.

contrast.label: Set-trained slider
contrast.note: A LoRA trained with no text, between two sets of the model's own clips: the top and bottom 20% along a measurement or along an axis found in real music. Usable from -1 to +1.

internal.label: The model's own axis
internal.note: A principal direction of the transformer's own activations across seeds of the same prompt, added back at sampling time. No text, no embedding model, and no training chose it; the labels come from the tags it moves.
